title: 369. Geometry, Spatial Thinking & Measurement: Volume of Pyramids
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.learningObjective: Apply the pyramid-volume formula to a supplied base area.
questions.question: A pyramid has base area \(30\text{ cm}^2\) and perpendicular height \(6\text{ cm}\). What is its volume?
questions.hint: Use base area and perpendicular height, including the pyramid factor.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate volume from a square base side and height.
questions.question: A pyramid has a square base of side \(4\text{ cm}\) and perpendicular height \(9\text{ cm}\). What is its volume?
questions.explanation: The base area is \(4^2=16\text{ cm}^2\). Thus \(V=\frac{1}{3}(16)(9)=48\text{ cm}^3\).
questions.hint: Find the base area before using the height.

questions.learningObjective: Find the volume of a rectangular-base pyramid.
questions.question: A pyramid has a rectangular base measuring \(6\text{ m}\) by \(5\text{ m}\) and perpendicular height \(8\text{ m}\). What is its volume?
questions.explanation: The base area is \(30\text{ m}^2\), so \(V=\frac{1}{3}(30)(8)=80\text{ m}^3\).
questions.hint: Calculate the rectangular base area first.

questions.learningObjective: Combine a triangular base area with the pyramid-volume formula.
questions.question: A pyramid's base is a right triangle with perpendicular legs \(6\text{ cm}\) and \(8\text{ cm}\). Its perpendicular height is \(15\text{ cm}\). What is its volume?
questions.explanation: The base area is \(\frac{1}{2}(6)(8)=24\text{ cm}^2\). Then \(V=\frac{1}{3}(24)(15)=120\text{ cm}^3\).
questions.hint: Distinguish the base triangle's area factor from the pyramid's volume factor.

questions.learningObjective: Solve the volume formula for base area.
questions.question: A pyramid has volume \(84\text{ cm}^3\) and perpendicular height \(7\text{ cm}\). What is its base area?
questions.explanation: From \(84=\frac{1}{3}B(7)\), the base area is \(B=\frac{3\cdot84}{7}=36\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.hint: Isolate base area in the pyramid-volume equation.

questions.concept: Height from a face slant height
questions.learningObjective: Recover the height of a regular square pyramid and find its volume.
questions.question: A regular square pyramid has base side \(6\text{ cm}\). The segment from the apex to the midpoint of a base edge has length \(5\text{ cm}\). What is the pyramid's volume?
questions.explanation: The height forms a right triangle with half a base side. Thus \(h=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4\text{ cm}\), and \(V=\frac{1}{3}(36)(4)=48\text{ cm}^3\).
questions.hint: Use the segment from the base center to an edge midpoint.

questions.learningObjective: Infer pyramid volume from an equal-base equal-height prism.
questions.question: A prism has volume \(360\text{ cm}^3\). A pyramid has the same base area and perpendicular height as that prism. What is the pyramid's volume?
questions.explanation: A prism has volume \(Bh\), whereas a pyramid has volume \(\frac{1}{3}Bh\). Hence the pyramid volume is \(\frac{360}{3}=120\text{ cm}^3\).
questions.hint: Compare the two volume formulas with the shared dimensions.

questions.learningObjective: Determine a pyramid-volume factor from changed dimensions.
questions.question: A pyramid's rectangular base length and width are each doubled, while its perpendicular height is tripled. By what factor does its volume increase?
questions.explanation: Base area increases by \(2\cdot2=4\), and height by \(3\). The volume factor is \(4\cdot3=12\).
questions.hint: Account for both dimensions of the base.

questions.concept: Small pyramid above a parallel section
questions.learningObjective: Use similarity to calculate the top pyramid's volume.
questions.question: A pyramid has volume \(216\text{ cm}^3\). A plane parallel to the base meets its axis at one-third of the full perpendicular height measured from the apex. What is the volume of the small pyramid above the plane?
questions.explanation: The small pyramid's linear scale is \(\frac{1}{3}\). Its volume is \(216\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^3=8\text{ cm}^3\).
questions.hint: Determine the linear scale from the apex before scaling volume.

questions.learningObjective: Recover a square pyramid's base side from height and volume.
questions.question: A pyramid has a square base, perpendicular height \(6\text{ cm}\), and volume \(128\text{ cm}^3\). What is its base side length?
questions.explanation: If the side is \(s\), then \(128=\frac{1}{3}s^2(6)=2s^2\). Thus \(s^2=64\) and \(s=8\text{ cm}\).
questions.hint: Express the square base area in terms of its side.
